devdoc.details: Handles all ERC-4626 vault interactions: deposit, redeem, preview, and slippage enforcement.      Both deposit() and withdraw() are fully synchronous, returning (bytes32(0), amount).      ## Slippage Enforcement      - Deposit: calls previewDeposit() immediately before deposit(), reverts if shares < preview      - Withdrawal: calls previewRedeem() immediately before redeem(), reverts if assets < preview      ## Token Flow      1. Router approves this module to spend tokens      2. This module pulls tokens from Router via transferFrom      3. This module approves the ERC4626 vault to spend tokens      4. This module calls vault.deposit() / vault.redeem()      5. Shares/assets are sent directly to the receiver (Account)      ## Absorbs VaultHelpers      This module contains the same defensive try-catch wrapping and slippage enforcement      that was previously in VaultHelpers.sol, making it fully self-contained.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

ExternalCallFailed().details: Used in try/catch wrappers that already emit `Events.ErrorLogBytes(lowLevelData)`

params.received: The actual amount of assets received
The actual amount of shares received

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

clearDepositOperationIds(uint256).details: Default no-op. Overridden by ERC7540 which manages the deposit reverse mapping.

clearWithdrawalOperationIds(uint256).details: Default no-op. Overridden by ERC7540 which manages the withdrawal reverse mapping.

deposit(address,address,uint256,address,.details: Synchronous ERC-4626 deposit. Pulls asset tokens from caller (Router),      deposits into the vault, and sends shares to the receiver (Account).      Returns (bytes32(0), sharesReceived) indicating sync completion.

params.amount: Amount of asset tokens to deposit
params.vault: The vault/pool address to deposit into

returns.operationId: Unique identifier for async tracking (bytes32(0) for sync)
returns.sharesReceived: Actual shares received (non-zero for sync, 0 for async)

extractMinAmountOut(bytes).details: Each module defines its own parameter encoding format.      Used by Deposit.sol/Withdraw.sol for async operations to store slippage bounds.

returns.minAmountOut: Minimum acceptable output amount (0 if not specified)

getDepositOperationIds(address,uint256).details: Default returns empty array. Overridden by ERC7540 which stores the deposit reverse mapping.

returns._0: Array of deposit operationIds mapped to this (account, requestId)

getWithdrawalOperationIds(address,uint25.details: Default returns empty array. Overridden by ERC7540 which stores the withdrawal reverse mapping.

returns._0: Array of withdrawal operationIds mapped to this (account, requestId)

initialize(string,address).details: Called by VaultManager during beacon proxy deployment.

returns.active: True if the module is operational, false otherwise

originalRequestId(bytes32).details: Default returns 0. Overridden by ERC7540 which stores the mapping.

params.operationId: The namespaced operationId returned by deposit()/withdraw()

returns._0: The original requestId from the ERC-7540 vault

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

previewDeposit(address,uint256).details: Returns the ERC-4626 preview estimate for deposit

params.assets: Amount of assets to simulate depositing

returns.shares: Expected shares that would be minted

previewRedeem(address,uint256).details: Returns the ERC-4626 preview estimate for redemption

params.shares: Amount of shares to simulate redeeming

returns.assets: Expected assets that would be returned

removeDepositOperationId(uint256,bytes32.details: Default no-op. Overridden by ERC7540 which manages the deposit reverse mapping.

removeWithdrawalOperationId(uint256,byte.details: Default no-op. Overridden by ERC7540 which manages the withdrawal reverse mapping.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdraw(address,address,uint256,address.details: Synchronous ERC-4626 redemption. Pulls share tokens from caller (Router),      redeems from the vault, and sends assets to the receiver (Account).      Returns (bytes32(0), assetsReceived) indicating sync completion.

params.amount: Amount of share tokens to redeem
params.owner: Address that owns the shares (typically the Router after transfer)
params.receiver: Address to receive underlying assets (the Account)
params.vault: The vault/pool address to withdraw from

returns.assetsReceived: Actual assets received (non-zero for sync, 0 for async)
returns.operationId: Unique identifier for async tracking (bytes32(0) for sync)

ErrorLogBytes(bytes).notice: Emitted when a low-level error occurs

clearDepositOperationIds(uint256).notice: Delete all deposit operationIds for an account's requestId

clearWithdrawalOperationIds(uint256).notice: Delete all withdrawal operationIds for an account's requestId

deposit(address,address,uint256,address,.notice: Execute a deposit into a vault

extractMinAmountOut(bytes).notice: Extract minAmountOut from module-specific encoded parameters

getDepositOperationIds(address,uint256).notice: Look up all deposit operationIds that share a given ERC-7540 requestId for a specific account

getWithdrawalOperationIds(address,uint25.notice: Look up all withdrawal operationIds that share a given ERC-7540 requestId for a specific account

isActive().notice: Checks if this vault module is currently active and usable

moduleName().notice: Returns the human-readable name of this vault module

originalRequestId(bytes32).notice: Look up the original ERC-7540 requestId from a namespaced operationId

pause().notice: Pause the vault module, preventing new operations

previewDeposit(address,uint256).notice: Preview expected shares from a deposit

previewRedeem(address,uint256).notice: Preview expected assets from a redemption

removeDepositOperationId(uint256,bytes32.notice: Remove a single deposit operationId from the per-account reverse mapping

removeWithdrawalOperationId(uint256,byte.notice: Remove a single withdrawal operationId from the per-account reverse mapping

withdraw(address,address,uint256,address.notice: Execute a withdrawal from a vault
